from.place: Upstream master declaration AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.smoothPurityIso (#1461); the Qlb case of the blueprint theorem for the unit object

title: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.smoothPurityIso
statement: Let l be a prime and k a field of characteristic p>0 with p != l. Let X, Y be separated schemes of finite type over Spec k (objects of Over (Spec k)) and f:X->Y a morphism over k whose underlying morphism of schemes is smooth of pure relative dimension d. Write Qlb for the condensed ring Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l, Qlb_Y for the tensor unit of the monoidal category D^b_c(Y)[[Qlb]] of bounded constructible module objects over Qlb on the pro-etale site of Y, Rf^! for boundedConstructibleUpperShriek (the right adjoint of Rf_!, built from a Nagata compactification of f), and Qlb_X(d) for the Tate twist tateTwistDerived X l d of WeilConjectures.TateTwist.ProEtale. Then there is an isomorphism (Rf^! Qlb_Y) ~= Qlb_X(d)[2d] in D(Mod_{Qlb_X}) (after the fully faithful inclusion of D^b_c(X)[[Qlb]]). The upstream declaration is a chosen isomorphism (data, @[no_expose]); it should be the purity isomorphism of SGA 4 XVIII 3.2.5 / Bhatt-Scholze 6.8, i.e. the inverse of gamma_{f,K} of [thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity] for K the unit object, composed with Lf^* of the unit being the unit.
